lineup.title: Model lineup
lineup.intro: Every claim is investigated independently by at least three models chosen for their different perceived leanings and origins. They all get the same neutral instructions.
lineup.leaningNote: Leaning labels describe how people across the spectrum tend to perceive each model family (Westwood, Grimmer & Hall, 2025). They are not instructions: no model is told to take a side.

funding.title: Funding and independence
funding.body: Parallaxa is run as a non-profit foundation. No single donor may provide more than 10% of the annual budget. We take no money from political parties, governments or platform companies. Donors above €1,000 are published. No model vendor may handle more than half of all investigations.

evals.title: Evaluation results
evals.intro: How the current setup scores on our gold set of claims, re-run nightly and after every model change. Mirror parity checks that equivalent claims from opposite sides get the same grade; language parity checks the same claim in English and Spanish.
evals.demo: Demo-mode runs use simulated verdicts and are not meaningful.
